intro: An electropeller is a specialized mechanical component engineered by the gnome inventor Wizbang Cranktoggle. Intended to power an explosive waterfowl decoy, a full bag of these gadgets was lost across Darkshore's freshwater rivers during an ill-fated nighttime outing.

p: Gnomish engineering requires precision, but the inventors behind it are not always so methodical. Wizbang Cranktoggle, an eccentric gnome operating out of Auberdine, devised the electropeller as a propulsion component for an experimental, self-propelled, exploding duck decoy. While scouting the waterways of Darkshore after having one too many drinks, Cranktoggle blacked out and returned to consciousness hours later with singed hair and an empty pack. His collection of electropellers had tumbled into the freshwater currents, leaving the components scattered throughout Darkshore's rivers and lakes until recovered by patient anglers.
